rationale: Reproducible feature classification supplies the repeatable binary inspection needed to run the mapped partition-and-test procedure. Establishing it checks ordinary test instantiation; it does not establish persistence of the feature transition or the evidential bridge from feature states to dates.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Apply the fixed feature-presence rule repeatedly to usable references and check that classifications are reproducible, retaining ambiguous or illegible observations as uncertain.
